fusions.name: Called Back
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt that deals 10 damage. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Recited Surge
fusions.desc: Recites a cone 6 tiles long that deals 12 damage to everything in it. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Unwritten Pause
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Fair Copy
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
